label_basis: Direct code-file dependency edges from the pinned Saleor ingestion graph. Expected paths are consumers of the changed file (incoming IMPORTS/CALLS/RENDERS edges). These labels measure direct dependency recovery, not complete behavioral impact.

cases.title: Cart drawer component change
cases.query: Identify the code entry points that consume the changed cart drawer component and could be affected by a rendering or interaction change.
cases.label_evidence: Pinned graph has direct IMPORTS edges from cart-drawer-wrapper.tsx and cart/index.ts to cart-drawer.tsx.

cases.title: Cart action behavior change
cases.query: Identify the UI components that call or import the changed cart action module and could be affected by a change to cart operations.
cases.label_evidence: Pinned graph has direct IMPORTS edges from cart-drawer.tsx and cart/index.ts to cart/actions.ts.

cases.title: Checkout summary state change
cases.query: Identify checkout steps that consume the checkout summary state, including possible effects on totals or checkout progression.
cases.label_evidence: Pinned graph has direct IMPORTS edges from payment-step.tsx and shipping-step.tsx to checkout-summary-context.tsx.

cases.title: Shipping step change
cases.query: Identify the parent checkout flow that composes the shipping step and could be affected by a shipping UI or state change.
cases.label_evidence: Pinned graph has a direct IMPORTS edge from saleor-checkout.tsx to shipping-step.tsx.

cases.title: Product variant selector change
cases.query: Identify components that compose the variant selector, which may be affected by changes to product option selection.
cases.label_evidence: Pinned graph has direct IMPORTS edges from variant-selection/index.ts and variant-selection-section.tsx to variant-selector.tsx.

cases.title: Product listing filter logic change
cases.query: Identify product listing pages and UI consumers of the shared filter logic that could be affected by a filtering change.
cases.label_evidence: Pinned graph has direct IMPORTS edges from the three listing pages, plp/index.ts, and use-product-filters.ts to filter-utils.ts. A test file is intentionally excluded from impact labels.
